summary: E2E test on /config-notificacoes covering Notificações (persistence + restore) and Templates WhatsApp (list, create, edit, delete, preview, restaurar padrão) using admin diego.haidmann@gmail.com. Notificações tab works perfectly (save persists after reload, restore returns defaults). Templates CRUD works and backend correctly blocks edit/delete of padrão. Two significant issues found: (1) BACKEND: restaurar-padrao duplicates default templates on every call (count went 13 → 19 after one click, delta +6). (2) FRONTEND: 'Preview' (eye) button shows raw template string with {cliente_nome} etc. instead of substituted example values. Additionally, the 'Duplicar' feature is missing from the UI even though whatsappAPI.duplicarTemplate and backend endpoint exist.

critical.issue: Every call re-inserts the 6 default templates without deleting the previous padrão set. _criar_templates_padrao(force=True) skips the dedup 'existe' check and never deletes; result: duplicates accumulate (observed 13 → 19 after one restore). Fix: before re-inserting when force=True, delete existing padrao=True templates for the user, OR de-dup by (usuario_id, nome, padrao=True) via upsert.

ui_bugs.issue: Eye button sets previewTemplate = template.mensagem (raw). Modal renders raw variables like {cliente_nome} instead of substituted preview (João Silva/850,00/etc.). Should call whatsappAPI.previewTemplate(template.mensagem) and render response.data.preview.

'Duplicar' feature is missing from UI. Requirement asks to duplicate a template; whatsappAPI.duplicarTemplate is defined and backend POST /whatsapp/templates/{id}/duplicar works, but no button in the UI triggers it. The green Copy button only writes to clipboard (navigator.clipboard.writeText).

issues: Task expected tab named 'Notificações' but actual text is 'Períodos e Canais'. Functional but wording mismatch.

action_items: Backend: fix restaurar-padrao to prevent duplication (delete padrao=True before re-insert on force, or upsert by nome+usuario_id+padrao).
Frontend: change Eye/preview button to call previewTemplate API and render substituted text; alternatively, always send template through the preview endpoint.
Frontend: add Duplicar button (Copy icon distinguished) that calls whatsappAPI.duplicarTemplate(id, novoNome) and refreshes the list.
Optional: cleanup any pre-existing duplicated padrão templates (side effect of the restore-padrao bug — DB now has many extras).
critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp_templates.py: _criar_templates_padrao(force=True) creates duplicates instead of replacing. Consider awaiting db.whatsapp_templates.delete_many({'usuario_id': usuario_id, 'padrao': True}) at top of force branch.
ConfigNotificacoes.js lines 971-978: preview onClick sets raw mensagem. Reuse gerarPreview() to fill previewTemplate with substituted text.
ConfigNotificacoes.js file has ~1167 lines and mixes two feature areas (Notificações + Templates). Consider splitting into two components/pages for readability.

Page has no data-testid attributes on any button/tab/input — testing has to rely on visible text; add data-testid attributes for tabs (tab-notificacoes, tab-templates), Save/Restore buttons, and per-template action buttons.
In criar/atualizar/duplicar_template routes, request body arguments are passed as query parameters — works but is non-idiomatic. Consider Pydantic body model.

seed_data_creation: Created + deleted TEST_Template_QA during test. No residual data. However, note DB now has extra duplicated padrão templates due to the restore-padrao bug hit during smoke tests + this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notificações persistence and restore verified end-to-end. Templates create/edit/delete/restore + padrão protection (400) verified. Remaining bugs are: preview substitution missing, duplicar feature missing from UI, restore-padrao backend duplicates. After main-agent fixes, retest: (a) restore-padrao does not increase template count beyond 6 defaults, (b) Eye preview replaces variables with example (João Silva etc.), (c) new Duplicar button creates a copy visible in list.
rca of the issue: restaurar-padrao bug RCA: routes/whatsapp_templates.py::_criar_templates_padrao when called with force=True bypasses the existence check but does NOT purge previous padrão records; each POST /templates/restaurar-padrao therefore inserts 6 new documents (uuid-differing) with padrao=True. Reproduction: call endpoint N times → collection grows by 6*N. Mitigation: at start of force branch execute db.whatsapp_templates.delete_many({'usuario_id': usuario_id, 'padrao': True}).
